sentences.en: You seem to be always assessing what people think about you.
sentences.zh: 你似乎总是评估别人对你有什么看法。

sentences.en: They assessed the land at nine million yen.
sentences.zh: 他们估价这块土地为九百万元日元。

sentences.en: He sold some assess at the market to a merchant from Pella.
sentences.zh: 他把一些货物卖给了菲拉的商人。
